newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower across the board on Tuesday, as price falls on the CBOT Project A overnight trading session discouraged local investors, traders said.
Prices were 40 to 170 yen lower, and the benchmark July 1998 was down 150 yen at 13,450 yen per tonne. Estimated volume was 67,503 lots.
The market gained during morning session, reflecting price gains of the CBOT corn market on Monday, traders said.
"But technical selling emerged by noon, and the lower CBOT overnight trading accelrated selling orders," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.55-1/4 per bushel at 0740 GMT, against $2.62-1/4 at Monday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean was traded at $8.15 per bushel at 0740 GMT, against $8.19 at Monday's close.
